metadata.title: Ontology API Map and Index for Automation Pipelines
metadata.description: Structured directory mapping programmatic access points, query paradigms, and schema profiles for automated ontology discovery, staging, and aggregation workflows.

repositories.name: NCBO BioPortal
repositories.automation_notes: Requires account for API key. Strict rate limits. Excellent for metadata extraction and concept mappings.

repositories.name: EMBL-EBI OLS4

auth.notes: Publicly accessible endpoint, no credential layer required for general reads.

repositories.automation_notes: Native Solr-backed search endpoint allows fast fuzzy/lexical retrieval. Perfect for staging parent-child graphs without auth overhead.

repositories.name: Linked Open Vocabularies (LOV)
repositories.primary_domain: Cross-Domain, Semantic Web & Core Web Meta
repositories.automation_notes: Ideal for discovering standard schemas like Dublin Core, FOAF, SKOS, and PROV-O via direct SPARQL ingress.

automation_frameworks.name: OBA (Ontology-Based APIs)
automation_frameworks.purpose: Automated OpenAPI Spec Generation from OWL schemas

automation_frameworks.name: ROBOT Tool
automation_frameworks.purpose: Materializing reasoner inferences, merging disparate subschemas, and filtering axioms

automation_frameworks.name: RDFlib
automation_frameworks.purpose: In-memory triplestore parser, graph slicing, and programmatic schema validation
